"""

# Load the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Set up the matplotlib figure and axes for a 2x2 grid
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

sns.stripplot(x='survived_str', y='age', data=df, ax=axes[1, 0], jitter=True, color='black', size=8, alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status')

axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Survived')

sns.stripplot(x='survived_str', y='fare', data=df, ax=axes[1, 1], jitter=True, color='black', size=8, alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Survival Status')
